audit_method: ProductMaster -> ProductVariant -> RetailerOffer -> ProductSourceRecord, with source/freshness and deduplication

conversation_protocol.requested: one retailer per ChatGPT chat thread
conversation_protocol.limitation: The current chat cannot create additional ChatGPT conversations.
conversation_protocol.fallback: Each retailer receives its own numbered audit manifest and Base44 checkpoint. At the end of each retailer audit, use the manifest as the handoff into a newly opened ChatGPT conversation.

stores.name: Macy's
stores.blocker: Department structure and sample products are publicly indexable, but exhaustive Base44 ingestion is blocked by HTTP 403 and Macy's published crawl controls prohibit internal search/catalog/v1 workarounds. Authorized bulk product access is required.

stores.name: Nordstrom
stores.blocker: Official product sitemaps enumerate 526,058 current product URLs, but the Base44 environment receives an anti-bot/browser interstitial for PDP metadata and the sitemap lacks brand/variant/price/availability fields. Published crawl controls disallow /api/* workarounds. An authorized Nordstrom bulk product source is required for exhaustive ingestion.

tiers.name: Independent/direct brand stores
tiers.ordering_rule: Generate from the shared BrandCatalog after Tier 1; prioritize brands appearing across the most audited retailers, then work downward so ProductMaster reuse increases and duplicate creation decreases.

tiers.name: Local and regional retailers
tiers.ordering_rule: Audit current local assortment after the national ProductMaster is mature; attach local offers to existing masters first and create new masters only for genuinely missing styles.

data_quality_rules: Do not infer unobserved size/color stock.
Do not create duplicate ProductMaster rows when a canonical style already exists.
Prefer official APIs/feeds; then authorized feeds; then structured/public HTML within published crawl controls.
Do not bypass access controls or blocked APIs.
Record prices and availability with freshness timestamps.
Do not treat image attribution as permission; public image display follows the separate image-rights policy.
